def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    drows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0]
    dcols=sorted(j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and g[0][j]!=0)
    cb=[]; prev=0
    for j in dcols: cb.append((prev,j-1)); prev=j+1
    cb.append((prev,w-1))
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for k,dv in enumerate(drows):
        top = drows[k-1]+1 if k>0 else 0
        bot = drows[k+1]-1 if k+1<len(drows) else h-1
        if bot-dv != dv-top:   # lower block height != upper block height
            continue
        for (c0,c1) in cb:
            uphas = any(g[i][j]!=0 for i in range(top,dv) for j in range(c0,c1+1))
            lowhas = any(g[i][j]!=0 for i in range(dv+1,bot+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1))
            if uphas and not lowhas:
                for d in range(1,bot-dv+1):
                    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                        res[dv+d][j]=res[dv-d][j]
    return res
